name: Start Sketch
tip: Start a 2D sketch: pick a plane or a flat face, or a sketch in the browser to edit it

name: Extrude
tip: Pull a sketch's profile into a solid (or cut with it) along its plane's normal

name: Revolve
tip: Turn a sketch's profile about an axis into a solid

name: Loft
tip: Join two or more profiles with a smooth solid

name: Sweep
tip: Run a profile along a path

name: Coil
tip: A spring or thread-like coil of a profile, by pitch and turns

name: Rib
tip: A thin web from an open sketch line to the faces it meets

name: Emboss
tip: Raise or cut text or a profile onto a face

name: Import
tip: Bring in a STEP, IGES or .brep file as a body

name: Decal
tip: Wrap an image onto a face

name: Hole
tip: Drilled, counterbored, countersunk or tapped holes at sketch points

name: Fillet
tip: Round chosen edges by a radius

name: Chamfer
tip: Bevel chosen edges by a distance

name: Shell
tip: Hollow the part to a wall thickness, leaving chosen faces open

name: Draft
tip: Lean chosen faces by an angle from a pull direction

name: Thread
tip: Model a thread on a cylindrical face

name: Split
tip: Split a body or faces with a plane or a surface

name: Combine
tip: Join, cut or intersect bodies

name: Thicken
tip: Give a face or surface a thickness

name: Direct
tip: Move, turn or size faces of the solid directly

name: Delete Face
tip: Take faces out and let the solid heal over the gap

name: Replace
tip: Replace faces with another face or surface

name: Plane
tip: A work plane: offset or angled from faces and planes

name: Axis
tip: A work axis through edges or points

name: Point
tip: A work point at a vertex or an intersection

name: UCS
tip: A user coordinate system: an origin and three axes

name: Rectangular
tip: Copy features along one or two directions

name: Circular
tip: Copy features about an axis

name: Sketch
tip: Copy features at a sketch's points

name: Mirror
tip: Mirror features across a plane

name: Move
tip: Move or rotate whole bodies

name: Copy
tip: Copy whole bodies

name: Convert to Sheet Metal
tip: Make this part sheet metal: thickness, bend radius and relief from the defaults

name: Line
tip: Lines in a chain from click to click, each end tied to the last

name: Midpoint Line
tip: A line drawn from its middle out to one end, the middle a point tied to it

name: Construction
tip: New lines are construction geometry: they guide, they make no profile

name: Center Point Circle
tip: A circle by its centre and a point on it

name: Tangent Circle
tip: A circle touching three lines

name: Three Point Circle
tip: A circle through three points

name: Three Point Arc
tip: An arc by its start, its end, and a point it passes through

name: Tangent Arc
tip: An arc leaving the end of a line or arc along it

name: Center Point Arc
tip: An arc by its centre, start and end

name: Two Point Rectangle
tip: A rectangle square to the sketch, corner to corner

name: Three Point Rectangle
tip: A rectangle at any angle: one side by two points, then its width

name: Two Point Center Rectangle
tip: A rectangle from its centre out to a corner; the centre is a point tied to its diagonals

name: Three Point Center Rectangle
tip: A rectangle at any angle from its centre: a side's middle, then its width; the centre stays tied

name: Center to Center Slot
tip: A slot by its two arc centres, then its width

name: Overall Slot
tip: A slot by its two ends, then its width

name: Center Point Slot
tip: A slot from its middle out to an arc's centre, then its width

name: Three Point Arc Slot
tip: A curved slot along an arc through three points, then its width

name: Center Point Arc Slot
tip: A curved slot along an arc about a centre, then its width

name: Spline Interpolation
tip: A smooth curve through the points clicked

name: Spline Control Vertex
tip: A smooth curve pulled toward the points clicked (a cubic B-spline's control polygon)

name: Center Point Ellipse
tip: An ellipse by its centre, one end of the major axis, then the minor axis

name: Axis Ellipse
tip: An ellipse by both ends of its major axis, then the minor axis

name: Bounding Box Ellipse
tip: An ellipse filling a box square to the sketch, corner to corner

name: Inscribed Polygon
tip: A regular polygon by its centre and a corner; set the sides above the view

name: Circumscribed Polygon
tip: A regular polygon by its centre and the middle of a side; set the sides above the view

name: Point
tip: A sketch point: a hole centre, or something to dimension to

name: Fillet
tip: Round the corner where two lines meet

name: Chamfer
tip: Bevel the corner where two lines meet

name: Text
tip: Place text for Emboss to raise or cut after the sketch

name: Project Geometry
tip: Bring edges or faces of the part onto the sketch plane as fixed geometry

name: Move
tip: Move chosen geometry from a base point to another

name: Copy
tip: Copy chosen geometry from a base point to another

name: Rotate
tip: Turn chosen geometry about a centre

name: Scale
tip: Scale chosen geometry about a base point

name: Stretch
tip: Move chosen geometry, the lines joined to it stretching to follow

name: Offset
tip: A copy of chosen geometry a distance to one side

name: Trim
tip: Cut a line back to the nearest lines it crosses

name: Extend
tip: Run a line's end on to the next line it meets

name: Split
tip: Split a line in two where it is clicked

name: Mirror
tip: Mirror chosen geometry across a line

name: Rectangular
tip: Copies of chosen geometry in a row

name: Circular
tip: Copies of chosen geometry about a centre

name: Dimension
tip: Size a line, circle or arc, or the distance or angle between two; the value drives the sketch

name: Automatic Dimensions
tip: Add dimensions until nothing in the sketch can move

name: Coincident
tip: Join two points

name: Collinear
tip: Put two lines on one line

name: Concentric
tip: Give two circles or arcs one centre

name: Fix
tip: Hold a point or curve where it is

name: Parallel
tip: Make two lines parallel

name: Perpendicular
tip: Make two lines square to each other

name: Horizontal
tip: Make a line level, or two points level with each other

name: Vertical
tip: Make a line plumb, or two points one above the other

name: Tangent
tip: Make a line or curve touch a curve smoothly

name: Smooth (G2)
tip: Join two curves with matching curvature

name: Symmetric
tip: Mirror two points or curves about a line and hold them so

name: Equal
tip: Give two lines one length or two circles one size

name: Show Constraints
tip: Show or hide the constraint marks

name: Show Freedom
tip: Show how each entity can still move

name: Look At
tip: Turn the view square onto the sketch

name: Finish Sketch
tip: Close the sketch and keep it

name: Cancel
tip: Close the sketch and throw its changes away

name: Measure
tip: Distances, angles and sizes between what is picked

name: Wall
tip: The wall thickness at a point

name: Mass
tip: The part's mass, volume and area

name: CG Marker
tip: Show the centre of gravity in the view

name: Section
tip: Cut the view open with a plane to look inside

name: Check
tip: Check the solid for faults

name: iProperties
tip: The part's properties: physical, summary, project

name: Materials
tip: Choose and edit the part's material

name: Analyze Interference
tip: Find where components overlap

name: Visual Style
tip: How the model is drawn: shaded, with edges, hidden edges, wireframe and the rest

name: Section
tip: Cut the view open with a plane

name: Pastel Parts
tip: Give each part a pastel colour of its own

name: Explode
tip: Pull an assembly's parts apart along their joints

name: Relationships
tip: Show or hide the joint and constraint marks in an assembly

name: Ground Plane
tip: A floor under the model, with its grid (Settings > Appearance has the rest)

name: Reflections
tip: The model mirrored in the ground plane; needs the ground plane on

name: Ground Shadows
tip: The model's shadow cast down on the ground plane

name: Object Shadows
tip: Parts shadow each other, from the lighting style's key light

name: Ambient Shadows
tip: Darkens creases and corners light can't reach, and the ground right under the model

name: Orbit
tip: The left button turns the view

name: Pan
tip: The left button moves the view

name: Zoom
tip: The left button zooms the view

name: Fit All
tip: Fit everything in the view

name: Parameters
tip: The part's parameters: names, values and what they drive

name: Save
tip: Write the part to its file

name: Open
tip: Open a part or assembly

name: Settings
tip: Theme, colours, units, mouse and keyboard shortcuts

name: Create Version
tip: Save the document and mark it as its next named version, with a name and notes

name: Versions
tip: The document's versions and saves, and the parts it places

name: Compare
tip: The newest version against the part as it is now: changed faces and the volume added and removed

name: Release
tip: Release the document as its next revision: a named version and its STEP, kept outside the history

name: Update All
tip: Every pinned part to its newest version

name: mm
tip: Show lengths in millimetres

name: cm
tip: Show lengths in centimetres

name: m
tip: Show lengths in metres

name: in
tip: Show lengths in inches

name: ft
tip: Show lengths in feet

name: Place
tip: Place a component from a file

name: Content Center
tip: Place standard parts: screws, nuts, washers, pins

name: Pattern
tip: Copy components in a row or about an axis

name: Mirror
tip: Mirror components across a plane

name: Copy
tip: Copy components

name: Free Move
tip: Drag a component where it can move

name: Free Rotate
tip: Turn a component where it can turn

name: Joint
tip: Join two components by a joint: rigid, revolute, slider, cylindrical, ball

name: Constrain
tip: Mate, flush, angle or tangent between two components

name: Bill of Materials
tip: The components and how many of each

name: Parameters
tip: The assembly's parameters

name: Explode
tip: Pull the parts apart along their joints

name: Start 2D Sketch
tip: Start a 2D sketch on a plane or flat face

name: Face
tip: A flat face of sheet from a closed profile

name: Contour Flange
tip: A flange from an open profile run along an edge

name: Flange
tip: A flange bent up from an edge

name: Contour Roll
tip: A rolled shape from a profile revolved

name: Lofted Flange
tip: A flange lofted between two profiles

name: Hem
tip: Fold an edge back on itself: single, double, teardrop, rolled

name: Fold
tip: Fold the sheet along a sketch line

name: Jog
tip: Two bends offsetting the sheet along a sketch line

name: Bend
tip: Bend between two faces

name: Cut
tip: Cut through the sheet with a profile

name: Corner Seam
tip: Close or open the corner where two flanges meet

name: Corner Relief
tip: The relief cut at bend corners

name: Corner Round
tip: Round sheet corners

name: Corner Chamfer
tip: Bevel sheet corners

name: Rip
tip: Rip a gap along an edge

name: Unfold
tip: Lay bends flat to work across them

name: Refold
tip: Fold unfolded bends back

name: Split
tip: Split sheet faces

name: PunchTool
tip: Punch a library shape at sketch points

name: Insert Hardware
tip: Self-clinching nuts, studs and standoffs at sketch points

name: Create Flat Pattern
tip: Make the part's flat pattern

name: Go to Flat Pattern
tip: Show the part laid flat

name: Sheet Metal Defaults
tip: The thickness, bend radius and reliefs the part uses

name: Rules
tip: The sheet metal rules and their values

name: Convert to Part
tip: Make this a plain part again

name: Bend Table
tip: Each bend: its direction, angle and radius

name: Save Copy As DXF/DWG
tip: Write the flat pattern to a DXF or DWG

name: Extents
tip: Show the flat pattern's size

name: Bend Lines
tip: Show the bend lines

name: Tangents
tip: Show where bends meet flats

name: Punch Centres
tip: Show punch centres

name: Go to Folded Part
tip: Show the part folded

name: Base
tip: Place the first view of a part or assembly

name: Projected
tip: Views projected from a view

name: Auxiliary
tip: A view square to an edge

name: Section
tip: A section view along a cutting line

name: Detail
tip: An enlarged view of an area

name: Break
tip: Shorten a long view with a break

name: Break Out
tip: Cut part of a view away to show inside

name: Crop
tip: Crop a view to a boundary

name: New Sheet
tip: Add a sheet

name: Dimension
tip: Dimension edges, circles and points

name: Baseline
tip: Dimensions from one baseline

name: Ordinate
tip: Ordinate dimensions from an origin

name: Chain
tip: Dimensions end to end

name: Hole and Thread
tip: A note on a hole or thread

name: Feature Control Frame
tip: A geometric tolerance

name: Datum Identifier
tip: A datum letter

name: Surface
tip: A surface texture symbol

name: Welding
tip: A weld symbol

name: Datum Target
tip: A datum target

name: Edge
tip: An edge symbol

name: Text
tip: Text on the sheet

name: Leader Text
tip: Text with a leader

name: Automated Centerlines
tip: Centre marks and lines on every hole and cylinder

name: Center Mark
tip: A centre mark on a circle

name: Centerline
tip: A centreline between two points

name: Bisector
tip: A centreline between two lines

name: Parts List
tip: The parts list table

name: Balloon
tip: A balloon on a part

name: Auto Balloon
tip: Balloon every part of a view

name: Export PDF
tip: Write the drawing to a PDF

name: Export DXF
tip: Write the drawing to a DXF

name: Export DWG
tip: Write the drawing to a DWG (AutoCAD 2000)

name: Zoom All
tip: Fit the sheet in the window

name: Update
tip: Bring views up to date with the model

tip: Make the solid a thermoformed part: material, thickness, mould side

name: Form
tip: Simulate forming: where the sheet thins

name: Materials
tip: Thermoforming materials

name: Trim
tip: Trim the formed sheet

name: Plug
tip: A plug assist

name: Cutout
tip: A cutout in the formed part

name: Vents
tip: Vent holes in the mould

name: Draft
tip: The draft of every face against the pull

name: Thickness
tip: The formed wall thickness

tip: Faces that lock the part in the mould

name: Animate
tip: Play the forming

name: Export CSV
tip: Write the thickness map to a CSV

tip: The mould for the part

name: Export
tip: Write the mould to a STEP

name: Edit Formed Part
tip: The thermoform's material, sheet and mould side, edited

name: Check Forming
tip: The formed wall: thinnest and thickest, against the material's limit

name: Make Mould
tip: The mould the sheet is formed on

name: Simulated Wall
tip: The formed part's wall as simulated or as modelled
